# 🌿 Desi2Door — Farm Fresh Delivery Platform

> **Fresh From Farm to Doorstep** — A complete e-commerce platform for fresh groceries, meat, dairy and organic products.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Node.js v18+
- MongoDB (local or MongoDB Atlas)
- npm or yarn

### 1. Clone & Install
```bash
# Install all dependencies
npm run install:all
```

### 2. Configure Environment
```bash
# Copy example env
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env

# Edit with your values
nano backend/.env
```

**Required `.env` variables:**
```env
PORT=5000
MONGO_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/desi2door
JWT_SECRET=your_super_secret_key_here

# Twilio WhatsApp (optional but recommended)
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=ACxxxxx
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=your_auth_token
TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM=whatsapp:+14155238886
RETAILER_WHATSAPP_TO=whatsapp:+91XXXXXXXXXX

# Admin Credentials
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@desi2door.com
ADMIN_PASSWORD=Admin@123
```

### 3. Seed Database
```bash
npm run seed
```
This creates:
- 50+ sample products across all categories
- Admin user (credentials from .env)

### 4. Run Development Servers
```bash
# Terminal 1 - Backend
npm run dev:backend

# Terminal 2 - Frontend
npm run dev:frontend
```

- **Frontend:** http://localhost:3000
- **Backend API:** http://localhost:5000/api
- **Admin Dashboard:** http://localhost:3000/admin

---

## 🌐 Features

### Customer Features
- ✅ Browse by category (Meat, Fish, Vegetables, Dairy, Organic, etc.)
- ✅ Search products
- ✅ Add to Cart with quantity selector
- ✅ Wishlist
- ✅ Checkout with delivery time slot selection
- ✅ Cash on Delivery only
- ✅ Order history
- ✅ Printable invoice
- ✅ WhatsApp "Chat with Us" button
- ✅ Mobile-first responsive design

### Admin Dashboard
- ✅ Analytics (today's sales, total sales, order counts)
- ✅ 7-day sales chart
- ✅ View & manage all orders
- ✅ Update order status (Pending → Confirmed → Out for Delivery → Delivered)
- ✅ Delete orders
- ✅ Export orders as CSV
- ✅ Add / Edit / Delete products
- ✅ Upload product images
- ✅ Set stock availability & featured status

### Notifications
- ✅ WhatsApp notification to retailer on every order (via Twilio Sandbox)
- ✅ Includes customer name, phone, address, items, total

---

## 📱 WhatsApp Notification Setup (Twilio)

1. Sign up at [twilio.com](https://www.twilio.com)
2. Go to **Messaging → Try it out → Send a WhatsApp message**
3. Join sandbox: Send `join <sandbox-word>` to `+1 415 523 8886`
4. Copy credentials to your `.env`

## 🐳 Docker Deployment

```bash
# Copy and configure env
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env

# Build and start all services
docker-compose up -d

# Seed database
docker exec desi2door-backend node utils/seeder.js
```

---

## 🔐 Security Features
- bcrypt password hashing
- JWT authentication with expiry
- Admin-only route guards
- Environment variables for secrets
- CORS configuration
- Input validation

---

## 📦 Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Frontend | React.js, React Router v6 |
| State | Context API |
| Styling | CSS Modules + CSS Variables |
| Backend | Node.js, Express |
| Database | MongoDB, Mongoose |
| Auth | JWT + bcrypt |
| Notifications | Twilio WhatsApp API |
| Fonts | Baloo 2 + Hind (Google Fonts) |
